reports.title: Westrock Coffee Company Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: The Company is reaffirming its 2026 guidance for Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA of $90.0 million to $100.0 million, which was provided in its earnings release dated March 10, 2026. In addition, the Company is providing its preliminary 2027 guidance for Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA of approximately $130.0 million.
